Replied in #inc-vtg-hartford to you:

Your first report was at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. While the kiosks were down, your post said the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Mateo's 11:03 AM post says kiosk 1 was back and the guard checked in trailer 8836. Your 11:08 AM post says both lanes were working as of 11:07.

The channel doesn't record anything else the guard did, so anything beyond the clipboard would need to come from the guard or Mateo.
